classifications.label: Hypertensive Crisis (Ikibazo gikomeye cyane)
recommendations: Gana ivuriro ryihuse bitarenze uyu munsi
Gabanya umunyu kandi urye indyo yuzuye
Gana ikigo cy'ubuzima kikwegereye kugira ngo bongere bagusuzume nyuma y'ibyumweru bine

classifications.label: Likely Hypertension Stage 2
recommendations: Rya neza kandi ukore imyitozo ngororamubiri buri munsi
Irinde itabi n'inzoga nyinshi
Gana ikigo cy'ubuzima kikwegereye kugira ngo bongere bagusuzume nyuma y'ibyumweru bine

classifications.label: Likely Hypertension Stage 1
recommendations: Wongere imyitozo ngororamubiri
Gabanya ibiryo birimo umunyu mwinshi n'ibinure
Gana ikigo cy'ubuzima kikwegereye kugira ngo bongere bagusuzume nyuma y'ibyumweru bine

classifications.label: Elevated (Umuvuduko uri hejuru gato)
recommendations: Gabanya umunyu kandi urye imbuto n'imboga nyinshi
Kora imyitozo ngororamubiri kandi wirinde imihangayiko
Gana ikigo cy'ubuzima kikwegereye kugira ngo bongere bagusuzume nyuma y'ibyumweru bine

classifications.label: Normal (Umuvuduko ukwiye)
recommendations: Komeza ubuzima bwiza urimo
Komeza kwisuzumisha uko ubishishikarijwe n'abaganga

classifications.label: Possible Diabetes (Hashobora kuba harimo diyabete)
recommendations: Irinde ibinyobwa birimo isukari nyinshi
Gana ikigo cy'ubuzima kikwegereye kugira ngo bongere bagusuzume nyuma y'ibyumweru bine

classifications.label: At Risk (Pre-diabetes)
recommendations: Gabanya ibiryo n'ibinyobwa birimo isukari
Gana ikigo cy'ubuzima kikwegereye kugira ngo bongere bagusuzume nyuma y'ibyumweru bine

classifications.label: Normal (Isukari iri ku rugero rwiza)
recommendations: Komeza kurya indyo yuzuye
Komeza gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri buri gihe

classifications.label: Obesity Class III
recommendations: Shaka inama z'abaganga kugira ngo ugabanye ibiro mu buryo burambye

classifications.label: Obesity Class II
recommendations: Gabanya igihe umara nicaye, wongere imyitozo ngororamubiri

classifications.label: Obesity Class I
recommendations: Gira akamenyero ko kurya neza no gukora siporo buri munsi

classifications.label: Overweight
recommendations: Genzura ingano y'ibiryo urya kandi uhitemo ibiryo bitanga ubuzima

classifications.label: Normal (Ibiro bijyanye n'uburebure)
recommendations: Komeza akamenyero keza ufite k'ubuzima

classifications.label: Underweight (Ibiro bike cyane)
recommendations: Rya indyo yuzuye irimo poroteyine nyinshi
Gana ivuriro bakugire inama nyuma y'ibyumweru bine
